caption:
Stock market news | Nifty faces resistance near 26,000 as 26,023 gap up

The Nifty index met resistance close to the *26,000* mark, with the Gift Nifty quoted at *26,023*, pointing to an opening gap of roughly *100* points. Foreign portfolio investors are buying, and global market cues are key drivers, so the resistance level may shape short-term market direction.
